title: Qizqapan, Koya & Drive to Erbil
full_text:
Departure from Sulaymaniyah, and head to Erbil.
Stop at Zarzi Village to visit Qizqapan, an archaeological rock relief from the Medes period.
The village itself also caves with the footage of the neanderthal and over 13000 years of farming history.
Drive to Koya, with a short tea break at the historical Koya Fort.
Visit the British Mill, a still functional mill built by the british around 100 years ago
Arrival in Erbil, time to explore the city’s vibrant nightlife and farewell dinner in Erbil.
